title: claytonia mutandra
intro: Claytonia mutandra, commonly known as Winter Purslane, is a perennial herb native to North America. It is prized for its edible leaves, stems, and flowers, which are rich in vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants, providing numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, as well as potential therapeutic actions such as wound healing and antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Winter Purslane include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Furthermore, Winter Purslane has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including digestive issues and respiratory problems, making it a valuable addition to herbal remedies.
